scope: Read-only mathematical review of the CPWL construction passage and four separate subfigure sources; no source edits or builds.
checks: Both constructions use the same proof-environment heading style. The equality-hyperplane refinement explicitly fixes pairwise affine ordering on every full-dimensional cell.

The local-maxima min representation and the sum / maximum-of-complementary-sums DC identity are valid, with attribution to Brandenburg et al., ICLR 2025, Appendix B, Construction B.2. Original Kripfganz-Schulze attribution is mediated by this cited exposition, not an independently read original.
The three displayed envelopes have minimum f globally. Rational arithmetic checked all affine equality intervals, including both unbounded tails.
Pruning repeated and redundant envelopes before summation preserves their minimum and yields a valid, potentially different DC pair; the new preceding sentence explicitly acknowledges this pruning.

Every polyline vertex agrees exactly with its advertised formula, and every genuine breakpoint is included. All displayed g and u curves have nondecreasing slopes; both displayed -h curves have nonincreasing slopes.
The convex-fold and local-maxima plots use the same global f on their respective intervals [-3,3] and [-6,5]. Extra local-maxima component folds at -5,-3,3 cancel in the difference.
Each figure is composed in TeX from two separately rendered PDF files with individual subcaptions. Captions accurately describe the constructions and convex/concave signs.
Both new local-maxima PNGs visually inspected: labels are legible, curves match the source polylines, and the wider range exposes the additional folds.
